status: post-hoc diagnostics declared after original validation failures were seen
selection: For each existing phase baseline independently, minimize equal-trial mean squared causal 0.5s forecast error over all completed, originally admitted non-timing training trials. No parameter optimization. Tie break by listed hypothesis order.
freeze_before_diagnostic_validation: Write training-choice.json before computing diagnostic validation forecasts.
validation_scope: Previously scored validation is reused only for post-hoc diagnostics, not a new unseen confirmation; no refitting to validation.
short_horizon: Also calculate fixed 0.1s forecasts for every originally admitted trial under original sign +1, delay 0, both phase baselines; no selection or new pass gate.
limitations: Commanded acceleration proxy, 100Hz left-held reconstruction, unknown physical input tracking, uncertain global encoder phase. These hypotheses cannot prove a physical fault or validate transfer.
